question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom/phrase.**

Work out
solution:
The correct answer is "**Exercise or develop a plan".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrasal verb "**work out**" has the following meanings:

 
• To exercise, either in general or by targeting a specific part of the body.
 
• To develop or refine something, such as a plan, strategy, etc.
 
 
• **Example**: *Rohan's plan to spoil his rival's dance performance didn't **work out**__.*
 
 

 
• We use the given idiom in both a literal sense as well as a phrasal verb.
 
• When used **literally**, we mean work out as a physical exercise to keep the body active.
 
• When used as a **phrasal verb**, we mean work out as a plan for a situation or scenario one is dealing with.
